Content: Current validation after intercepted chat wiki tool calls, chat model metadata, stop-generation, hydrated chat context, context usage meter, robust Ctrl+V copied-image paste handling, CI coverage workflow, Doxygen Pages workflow, and benchmark-probe updates is dotnet test MemorySmith.slnx -v minimal with 146 passing NUnit tests. The solution build covers MemorySmith.Core, MemorySmith.Storage, MemorySmith.App, MemorySmith.Benchmarks, and MemorySmith.Tests. Focused chat/page coverage lives in PagesAndChatTests, including page assets, provider attachments, Ollama streaming token usage, trusted temp-file image payloads, raw-HTML rendering, GitHub error guidance, full-memory context hydration beyond the leading search snippet, and intercepted MemorySmith toolCalls/JSON-RPC tools/call execution before the final answer. SearchBenchmarkTests now includes 32 lexical, semantic, hybrid, source-link, MCP, and chat/search dogfooding probes for model-used metadata, Stop generation cancellation, compact chat history, context-window usage/rate-limit display, intercepted MCP/wiki tool calls, GitHub model guidance, Claude Haiku before Sonnet preference terms, and Ctrl+V copied-image paste terms. SecurityAndSourceLinkTests covers request guard behavior plus the remote API without API key diagnostics warning. MemoryMaintenanceTasksTests covers configured maintenance interval labels. MemoryApplicationServiceTests covers Lucene lexical tokenization, token fallback search, and CI-safe fake-provider embedding ranking. Benchmark smoke validation remains available through the BenchmarkDotNet search benchmark project, but the normal regression gate is the full NUnit suite.
Title: Current validation baseline
